title: Maintenance Plan Schema
description: Schema for defining maintenance plan entries in the system. Each entry includes a unique ID, name, description, start and end dates, an active status, and a list of triggers that activate the maintenance plan. The triggers can be time-based, usage-based, or condition-based.

subscription.description: Subscription details for Usage-based and Condition-based triggers.

api.description: API type (alarms, events, measurements, managedobjects, operations).

examples.name: Quarterly Server Check
examples.description: Perform server health checks and updates every quarter.

id.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance entry.

description.description: Detailed description of the maintenance entry.

startDate.description: Start date and time for the maintenance.

endDate.description: End date and time for the maintenance.

active.description: Indicates whether the maintenance entry is active.

on.description: List of maintenance triggers. The maintenance plan is activated if ANY of these trigger conditions are met (OR connection).

interval.description: Interval for time-based maintenance using ISO 8601 duration format.

counter.description: Single counter for usage-based maintenance. Defines the criteria for a usage-based trigger.

valueFragment.description: Fragment or field to extract the value from. The valueFragment is a JSONPath expression (e.g., $.property.subproperty[0].value, $.items[*]) that specifies the path to the value within the data structure. The pattern provides basic validation for common JSONPath expressions (dot notation, bracket notation with indices or quoted keys, simple wildcards like [*] or .* at the end); full validation for all JSONPath features occurs at runtime.

conditions.description: List of conditions for condition-based maintenance. The maintenance plan is activated if ALL of these conditions are met (AND connection).

valueFragment.description: Fragment or field to extract the value from. The valueFragment is a JSONPath expression that specifies the path to the value within the data structure.

operator.description: Operator for the condition. Allowed: gt (greater than), lt (less than), eq (equal).

value.description: Value to compare against for the condition.
